Class CatService

java.lang.Object
service.CatService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Service
public class CatService extends Object implements Service
Service layer responsible for managing Cat entities.

This class provides business operations such as creation, retrieval, update, deletion, filtering, and JSON serialization of cat data. It acts as an intermediary between higher-level components and the CatDao.
